captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: Production AI panel/settings and adaptive worker with a read-only local GGUF and projector; synthetic requests only; see stage9.json. Verify mode reads embedded resources only.
limitations: Native model path entered through the real text binding; native Browse gesture not tested. No download, personal files, clipboard, device, performance benchmark or physical input. Idle time is advanced through the production check. Only the isolated owned idle worker is terminated for exit detection.
